verses.text: Jude, servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, to those wey God Papa don call, wey e love and wey Jesus Christ dey keep:
Make mercy, peace and love plenty for una.

Beloved, as I dey try well well to write to una about di salvation wey we share, I see say e necessary to write to una to beg una make una fight hard for di faith wey dem don give di holy people one time for all time.
For some men don enter secretly, dem wey dem don write about long ago for dis judgment, ungodly men, wey turn di grace of our God to shameless living, and deny our only Lord, Jesus Christ.
Now I wan remind una, though una don know all dis one time before, say di Lord, after e save di people out of di land of Egypt, destroy afterward those wey no believe.
Angels wey no keep dem own place of authority, but leave dem own home, e don keep dem inside chains wey no dey end, under darkness, for di judgment of di great day.

Just as Sodom and Gomorrah and di cities wey dey around dem give dem own selves over to sexual immorality and go after strange flesh, dem dey stand as example, as dem dey suffer di punishment of fire wey no dey end.
Yet in di same way, dis dreamers also dey defile di flesh, despise authority, and speak evil of glorious ones.
But Michael di archangel, when e dey argue with di devil and dey dispute about di body of Moses, no dare bring accusation of blasphemy against am, but talk say, “Make di Lord rebuke you.”
But dis people dey speak evil of wetin dem no know. Wetin dem know by instinct, like animals wey no get sense, na inside dem dey destroy dem own selves.
Woe to dem! For dem don walk di way of Cain, and run greedily inside di error of Balaam for reward, and perish inside di rebellion of Korah.

Dis people na hidden rocks inside your love feasts, when dem dey feast with una, dey feed dem own selves without fear; clouds without water, wey wind dey carry; trees without fruit for harvest time, wey don die two times and dem don uproot;
wild waves of di sea, wey dey foam out dem own shame; wandering stars, wey di blackest darkness don dey kept for dem forever.
Enoch also, di seventh from Adam, prophesy about dem and talk say, “Look, di Lord come with tens of thousands of im holy ones,
to execute judgment on all, and to convict all di ungodly of all dem ungodly deeds wey dem don do in ungodly way, and of all di hard things wey ungodly sinners don speak against am.”
Dis people na grumblers, complainers, dey walk after dem own lusts, dem mouth dey speak proud things, and dem dey flatter people for dem own advantage.
But una, beloved, remember di words wey di apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ don talk before;
how dem tell una say, “For di last time, mockers go dey, dey follow dem own ungodly lusts.”
Dis na di people wey dey cause division, wey dey follow dem own natural desires and no get di Spirit.
But una, beloved, dey build una own selves up inside your most holy faith, dey pray inside Holy Spirit,
keep una own selves inside God love, dey wait for di mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring una enter life wey no dey end.
Show mercy to some, wey dey doubt;
and save some, dey snatch dem out of di fire; and to some show mercy with fear, dey hate even di cloth wey flesh don stain.
Now to di one wey fit keep una from stumbling, and make una stand before im glory without blemish with great joy,
to di only God our Saviour, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, power and authority, before all time, now, and forever. Amen.
